verdict.rationale: Metorial's first-party docs say it ships official TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs. They include a code sample (`metorial.connect` with an OpenAI adapter), typed error handling, a recommended `@metorial/ai-sdk` package, and provider integrations for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. A runtime probe confirmed the developer quickstart is live. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of installing and using the SDKs (e.g., package-registry evidence or a community build report).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Metorial gives developers official TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs to connect AI agents to tools in minutes.
The Metorial SDK throws typed errors that help you identify and handle specific failure scenarios.
The Vercel AI SDK integration (`@metorial/ai-sdk`) is the recommended way to use Metorial in TypeScript applications.
The Anthropic provider integration lets you use Metorial's MCP tools with Claude models (Sonnet, Opus, and Haiku).
